description: Params for `usage/record_presence`: epoch minutes (UTC, seconds / 60) in which the person was active in a Bridge window. Recording a minute twice stores it once, so a retry or a second window never double counts. Minutes beyond the current one or older than 7 days are dropped; more than 1,440 in one call is refused.

chats.description: Which chat was open in the window during some of those minutes, so your time can be split by project. A chat minute is kept only when the same minute is accepted from `minutes`; a minute keeps the first chat stored for it.
